gaps: Stance for Daria Zhelezniakova and Alice Pereira not verified (Firecrawl credits ran out before their UFCStats pages could be fetched); stance omitted for both.
Stance for the other 10 fighters comes from UFCStats; Tapology does not list stance.

Alice Pereira: Tapology lists a 2024-07-27 Dubai Fight 2 win over Hosana Enny that it flags as record-ineligible (record-padding promotion); it is excluded, so history matches her 6-1-0 Tapology record.
Ketlen Souza birth date conflict: Tapology says 1995-08-18, UFCStats says 1994-08-18 (UFC.com age 32 agrees with 1994); 1994-08-18 used.

Gerald Meerschaert: 15 early bouts (2007-2013), Ketlen Souza (2017-05-17 vs Rayla Nascimento) and Otari Tanzilovi (two 2018 Guram Fight Club bouts) have no round/time/event details on Tapology, so round/time/minutes are omitted and only the method category is given. For these bouts the eventName is the promotion/league name.
Several regional bouts have no division listed on Tapology; division is omitted for those.
Otari Tanzilovi: UFC.com lists height 70 in and no reach; Tapology/UFCStats say 5'9" with a 70 in reach. Tapology values are used.
Darya Zheleznyakova is billed on UFC.com as 'Daria Zhelezniakova' (slug dariya-zheleznyakova; the Tapology-linked slug daria-zheleznyakova redirects to search). The id stays darya-zheleznyakova.
Event names for many UFC bouts are the generic 'UFC Fight Night' as shown on Tapology's fighter page.
opponentRecord values show Tapology's pre-fight W-L, normalised to W-L-D by adding -0 when no draws are shown.
